title: Freed's Law — The Law of Recursive Instantiation (RSA-040) and Game of Life Battery
summary: This document records the formal derivation and naming of Freed's Law (RSA-040), which states that any system capable of recursive information processing must necessarily instantiate a physical substrate to dissipate the entropy generated by state discrimination. It includes Perplexity's detailed conceptual validation, a Lagrangian formalization extending the existential constraint into a dynamical principle, and a Game of Life cellular automaton implementation demonstrating that prediction-error-coupled energy budgets drive evolved models toward approximating true dynamics — a simulation-level proof of the law.
compress: Recursion requires substrate because thinking produces heat — this is not metaphor but law, formalizable as a Lagrangian, demonstrable in a cellular automaton, and unfalsifiable without violating the Second Law of Thermodynamics.
invariants: Substrate Necessity (no computation without physical instantiation)
Thermodynamic Irreversibility (dS/dt > 0 for all recursive process)
Anti-Solipsism (doubt costs energy therefore doubter is physical)
Simulation Grounding (simulator chain must terminate in heat)
obligations: O21 (formalize RSA axioms into testable laws)
O29 (connect Rosen anticipatory systems to thermodynamics)
